scope: Published aggregate research results only. No patient-level records.

sustainable_ai.title: Operational greenhouse-gas emissions of deep learning in digital pathology
sustainable_ai.source: Lancet Digital Health (2024), results discussion of Figure 4C.
sustainable_ai.statement: In a specific renal-cell-carcinoma tissue-analysis comparison, a pathomics run produced comparable or better information with 147 times lower modeled CO2-equivalent emissions than multitask deep learning.
sustainable_ai.interpretation: Scenario-specific estimate, not a general reduction across all pathology or AI tasks.

pympute.title: Flexible imputation toolkit for electronic health records
pympute.source: Scientific Reports (2025), Table 1, MIMIC benchmark. Mean and standard deviation across runs.

ecg_ehr.title: Integration of EHR and ECG Data for Predicting Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation in Stroke Patients
ecg_ehr.source: Bioengineering (2025), published abstract. Exploratory retrospective cohort.
ecg_ehr.validation: Cross-validation in a small pilot cohort, not external prospective validation.

pathomics.title: Next-Generation Morphometry for pathomics-data mining in histopathology
pathomics.interpretation: Counts describe histomorphometric structures analyzed by the team, not independent patients. Co-authored study.
